summary: An article page: the page shell, with the heading, subtitle, and byline in the article's header.
use: A blog post, news story, or press release: one article that is the page's content. Sections go in body; related links and the like go in after, below the article.

title.description: The page's own title, ahead of the site name. Leave it out on the home page, whose title is the site name alone.

site.description: The site name: the home link in the header and the end of the title.

heading.description: The article's title, the page's one h1.

subtitle.description: A subheading or standfirst under the title.

byline.description: Who and when, such as By Ana Ruiz · <time datetime="2026-05-04">4 May 2026</time>.

nav.description: The site navigation, in the header ahead of the h1.

body.description: The article itself, below its header.

after.description: Below the article, in main: related links, comments, and the like.

obligations: The heading names the article, and the byline says who wrote it and when, if the content says.
